decision: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
fact: The bodywork specification and the setup of the suspension has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
reason: Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team changed the bodywork specification of Car 18 under Parc Ferme with the approval of the Technical Delegate, this not being in accordance with Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. Also changes have been made to the set-up of the suspension, which is a breach of Article 40.9 and Car 18 is required to start the Sprint from pit lane.
rules_referenced: Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 18 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
